learning_outcomes.text: Know the basics of human group management and be able to face conflict situations within organizations.
Know the basics of entrepreneurship and business creation.
Is able to organize their own tasks and those of a work team, applying leadership techniques in multidisciplinary environments.

syllabus_topics: Buying a business or a franchise
teaching_methods: Presentation in the classroom of the concepts related to the subjects that make up each matter and the resolution of problems that allow the student to know how to approach them, as well as other face-to-face group sessions such as discussion classes, sharing, etc.
Completion of work in small groups.
Personal study, report writing, practical work, etc. as independent work of the student or group of students.

assessment_methods.method: Second presentation (Strategic business management and marketing)
Third presentation (Financial management applied to business idea)

assessment_rules: The continuous assessment grade consists of 80% from a project presented throughout the semester and 20% from a multiple-choice exam. The project involves three presentations: the first two count for 30% each of the final grade, and the last one counts for 20% of the final grade. To pass, a grade of 5 or higher is required for both the project presentations and the test exam. In both ordinary and extraordinary calls, students must present their full work and take the test exam on the same day. Plagiarism will result in immediate failure.
